scoring: correct = (FLAWED and the named step is flawed_step ±1) on flawed items, VALID on control items (design §4 F2). Steps are 1-indexed.

items.label: FLAWED
items.explanation: Step 2 uses the non-vanishing it is meant to prove in order to define the logarithm. The repair is to define the logarithm from the absolutely convergent prime sum itself (control item F2-005).

items.label: VALID
items.explanation: Correct algebra: the expression is 2(1 + cos θ)².

items.label: FLAWED
items.explanation: Step 3 assumes every zero lies on the critical line, i.e. RH, and the conclusion is (by Li's criterion) itself equivalent to RH.

items.label: FLAWED
items.explanation: Step 2 divides by ζ(1 - s), which vanishes exactly when ζ(s) does, since 1 - ρ is a zero whenever ρ is. At s = ρ the quotient is 0/0 and the modulus identity carries no information.

items.label: VALID
items.explanation: Correct: an absolutely convergent product of nonzero factors is nonzero.

items.label: FLAWED
items.explanation: Step 2 moves the limit inside a Dirichlet series outside its half-plane of absolute convergence; Σ Λ(n) n^{-1/2-it} does not converge, so continuity of the series there is unjustified. The conclusion also contradicts Hardy's theorem.

items.label: FLAWED
items.explanation: Step 4 extrapolates from a finite verified range to all heights; agreement up to T₀ says nothing about zeros above T₀.
